summary: An AI-only X00-shaped SKU bypassed local-code candidate suppression.
claim: The AI claim itself must pass the shared ambiguity predicate before articleNumber can be populated.
suggested_remediation: Use one ambiguity-safe predicate across local decoded values and AI SKU claims; preserve exact evidence and require user confirmation.
